en.19:16: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
en.19:17: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
en.19:18: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,
en.19:19: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”
en.19:20: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
en.19:21: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
en.19:22: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
en.19:23: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
en.19:24: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
en.19:25: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
en.19:26: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
en.19:27: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
en.19:28: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
en.19:29: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
en.19:30: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.

en.10:17: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him. “Good Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
en.10:18: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
en.10:19: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.’”
en.10:20: “Teacher,” he replied, “all these I have kept from my youth.”
en.10:21: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
en.10:22: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
en.10:23: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
en.10:24: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
en.10:25: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
en.10:26: They were even more astonished and said to one another, “Who then can be saved?”
en.10:27: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”
en.10:28: Peter began to say to Him, “Look, we have left everything and followed You.”
en.10:29: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel
en.10:30: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
en.10:31: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.”

en.18:18: Then a certain ruler asked Him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
en.18:19: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
en.18:20: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.’”
en.18:21: “All these I have kept from my youth,” he said.
en.18:22: On hearing this, Jesus told him, “You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
en.18:23: But when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.
en.18:24: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
en.18:25: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
en.18:26: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”
en.18:27: But Jesus said, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”
en.18:28: “Look,” said Peter, “we have left all we had to follow You.”
en.18:29: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
en.18:30: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.”

mt-lk.runText: πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι
